last.verdict: Investors cheered a big revenue beat and a sharply higher full-year sales forecast.

reasons.label: Sales forecast raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook lifted to $91–92B from $85–87B, a $5.5B jump at the midpoint.

reasons.label: Weight-loss drugs surge
reasons.text: Revenue up 39% to $24.4B; Mounjaro hit $10.7B (+65%) and Zepbound $5.3B in the U.S.

reasons.label: Profit outlook improving
reasons.text: Profit margin target raised to 52–52.5%; the EPS cut was only from $4.57/share acquired-research charges.

story: Lilly has beaten forecasts and raised guidance every quarter this year as Mounjaro and Zepbound sales soared. The stock jumped about 10% in February and April, then 3–5% in August. Falling drug prices remain the offsetting worry.
